svg.title: One turn, with a memory edit
svg.desc: The steps of one turn of a Letta agent. The user's message arrives. Model call 1 reads the whole prompt (in the notebook, 2,348 tokens) and returns a tool call, memory_replace, not a reply. Code runs the tool: it replaces the text in the block and returns the whole new block, which goes into the conversation; the system prompt is rebuilt with the new block. Model call 2 reads everything again plus the tool call and its result (2,574 tokens) and returns text with no tool call, which ends the turn and goes to the user. The user waits for both calls. A turn with no edit is one call; each search adds one more.
